+    def _is_all_or_any_call(self, node):
+        """Check if a node is calling all() or any()."""
+        return (
+            isinstance(node, ast.Call)
+            and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)
+            and node.func.id in ("all", "any")
+            and len(node.args) == 1
+            and not node.keywords
+        )
+
+    def _get_comprehension_info(self, node):
+        """Extract comprehension info from a generator/list/set comprehension.
+        
+        Returns a dict with 'elt', 'target', 'iter' keys if the node is a
+        single-level comprehension without conditions, otherwise returns None.
+        """
+        if isinstance(node, (ast.GeneratorExp, ast.ListComp, ast.SetComp)):
+            if len(node.generators) == 1 and not node.generators[0].ifs:
+                comp = node.generators[0]
+                return {
+                    'elt': node.elt,
+                    'target': comp.target,
+                    'iter': comp.iter,
+                }
+        return None
+
